title: Sea Cucumber
description: Simulate sea cucumber herds on a toroidal grid until they stop moving.
writeup:
## Approach

Two herds of sea cucumbers move on a toroidal grid: east-facing (`>`) move right, south-facing (`v`) move down. Each step, east-facing move first (simultaneously), then south-facing (simultaneously). A cucumber moves only if its target cell is empty.

## Part 1

Simulate step by step. In each phase, first collect all cucumbers that *can* move (checking the grid before any moves), then apply all moves at once. Count steps until no cucumber moves.
